Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision in
Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give my first name and keep the rest private, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were sitting at the time of the collision?
A: I was in the front passenger seat. My friend was driving, and we were stopped at a light on the main road.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?
A: Not really. I was looking at my phone. The first thing I remember is a big jolt from behind and my head snapping
forward and then back.
Q: Did you feel any pain right away?
A: Not immediately. By that evening my neck was stiff and I had a dull ache running into my shoulders. Over the next
couple of days it got worse, and I started getting headaches.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or ohter medical provider since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same night and then followed up with my primary care doctor. I've also
started physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Has anyone else been in the vehicle with you or been involved in any other incidents recently?
A: No one else was hurt. I haven't been in any other accidents that I can think of.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Just that the pain has been affecting my sleep and my ability to work a full shift, so I'm hoping this gets resolved
soon.
Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
